All Their-details fields render exactly as web: First name (Required), Last name (Required), Date of birth (Optional, DD/MM/YYYY), Classification (dropdown Not sure yet + Class 1-8), Provider (ProviderPicker showing dropdown of both sibling providers 'Test Provider 8c1af9aa' and 'Acacia Aged Care' plus 'Add a different provider' link that toggles to free-text with a back link), Statement delivery (Not sure yet / Email PDF / Provider portal / Paper). Created participant 'TESTIter209 Parity' with Class 4 + Acacia Aged Care + Email PDF; POST /v2/participants succeeded, done step shows forwarding email testiter209-c37e63@in.wayly.com.au, and new card correctly shows 'Classification 4 · Acacia Aged Care'.
critical_code_review_comments: participants.tsx line 407: `existing={active.map(p=>p.provider_name||'').filter(Boolean)}` correctly mirrors web sibling-provider derivation. Confirmed both siblings ('Test Provider 8c1af9aa' and 'Acacia Aged Care') appear in the dropdown.

ProviderPicker (participants.tsx 62-96) correctly handles both modes; toggle to freetext via 'Add a different provider' and back via 'Pick from existing providers' works. When there are no existing providers, it falls back to plain <Field> — matches web contract user confirmed.

Select component (ui.tsx 334-403) uses bottom-sheet Modal with proper testIDs of the form `${testID}-option-${value}`; empty value uses '-option-empty'. Consider ensuring the Provider modal shows a title — currently it does (label='Provider'), good.

Minor: In ProviderPicker `useState<'pick'|'type'>(uniq.length>0 && (!value||uniq.includes(value)) ? 'pick' : 'type')` is initialized once; if the sibling list loads asynchronously AFTER the form opens the picker could remain in 'type' mode. Not observed here (list preloaded before modal open) but worth a note.

The Provider Select uses `optional` label and shows 'Choose a provider' both in the placeholder text AND as the first option with value=''. This works, but selecting the empty option looks identical to placeholder — fine, matches web behaviour.
